non_blocking.section: Decision outcome (rules table, rows Engine and Memory, lines 47 and 51)
non_blocking.suggestion: Two new degraded states name no metric reason: "without it, `ruralzd` activates no Plugins and reports a degraded state" (line 47) and "`GOMEMLIMIT` MUST cover ... else the Node reports a degraded state" (line 51). P10 requires "a metric for every degraded state", and the owning document names every one of its own (`plugin_parked_bound_low`, `plugin_pool_degraded`, `plugin_signature_off`, `plugin_compiled_code_over_estimate`). Name them as `ruralz_node_degraded_info{reason="plugin_compiler_unavailable"}` and `{reason="plugin_memlimit"}`, each "(proposed to Observability)". The Memory row overlaps L1-1, so fold this into that fix. The body is at 1,496 of 1,500 words, so tighten wording elsewhere rather than delete text that closed earlier findings.

non_blocking.section: Decision outcome > Confirmation (SM-6 microbenchmark gate, line 100)
non_blocking.suggestion: "the `nightly` and `release` Macro latency gate fails a pooled Phase call ... above 50 µs at p99 (target)" stretches Testing and quality strategy. There the Macro latency row is the "SM-4 and SM-5 reference scenario, open-loop". SM-6 is a Microbenchmarks item whose `pr-full` gate is "alloc/op above its threshold", and Vision measures SM-6 by a "Per-Phase microbenchmark in CI". A word-neutral rewrite: "the `nightly` and `release` jobs fail the SM-6 microbenchmark on reference hardware as a seed budget above 50 µs at p99 (target)". This matches the Macro row's "or a seed budget exceeded" clause and the Benchmarks tier `pr-full; nightly`.

The amendment covers Data plane's row (line 40). Data plane line 43 also still says "The compiled-code cache is wazero's, keyed on the wazero version ...; its native code runs unsandboxed, so only the `ruralzd` user MAY write it (OQ-data-plane-11)". Add "and the sentence after the table" so conformance removes both.
